scope_notes: All Miri Rust modules under src/ are manifested; the complete pinned Miri repository archive is retained.

Four exact rustc_type_ir files are included for the structured type-system const exporter: ConstKind/ValTree/Expr definitions, generic parameter/placeholder and bound identities, the Const wrapper/value interface, and binder representations. This is a narrow source addition, not a rustc_type_ir crate-wide coverage claim.

The Miri runtime uses rustc_apfloat for IEEE floating-point and SIMD operations. Its exact crates.io source package is pinned by the retained rustc Cargo.lock version/checksum and archived separately; it is inventoried as runtime semantic code, not treated as an omitted build dependency.

The rustc_data_structures SortedMap root is the exact file imported by the pinned rustc_middle provenance map. Its adjacent SortedIndexMultiMap submodule and stable-hash support are not consumed by Miri provenance map operations and remain explicit unresolved support dependencies in the AST candidate graph.

The selected rustc source includes narrow runtime support files: allocator metadata (rustc_ast), attribute linkage data (rustc_attr_ir), codegen function attributes and MIR/type trees (rustc_middle), DefKind (rustc_hir), Miri’s CTRL_C_RECEIVED source (one rustc_const_eval crate root file), and SortedMap (rustc_data_structures). This does not select the compiler parser, type checker, query system, or full const-eval crate.
rustc_ast_ir/src/lib.rs is an exact-file root for the IntTy, UintTy, and FloatTy enum definitions serialized as stable primitive-type tags.
rustc_hir/src/hir.rs is an exact-file root for the Safety enum tags emitted by the type/function signature exporter; no broader rustc_hir coverage is implied.
rustc_type_ir/src/region_kind.rs is an exact-file root for the structured RegionKind serializer, including bound, static, erased, placeholder, inference, and error region cases.
rustc_type_ir/src/sty/mod.rs is an exact-file root for the LateParamRegion payload used by the structured RegionKind serializer.
rustc_type_ir/src/ty_kind.rs records rigid versus non-rigid alias-constant state used by the typed type-system const exporter.

upstream/rustc-source/compiler/rustc_middle/src/ty: Full pinned rustc_middle type-system source surface, including type/const representations and layout definitions consumed by Miri. The source inventory is not a claim that compiler type checking or query machinery must be reimplemented; those remain exporter-boundary candidates.

AES 0.9.3 hazmat runtime dependency is pinned from Miri Cargo.lock. Full crate src inventory is retained; x86 Lean hazmat uses the portable fixslice32 circuit, while alternative hardware implementations remain inventoried and do not imply a complete dependency equivalence proof.
GenMC is outside the port scope. The immutable Miri reference snapshot retains its optional GenMC bridge; no standalone GenMC source or Lean backend is included.
